name: Tort Reform
overview: Scripture calls for just and fair judgment, particularly protecting the vulnerable, as seen in Exodus 23:6 which warns against perverting the cause of the poor. God's intentions toward His people are for peace and a hopeful future (Jeremiah 29:11), reminding us that true rest and resolution come through Christ (Matthew 11:28). The biblical narrative encourages reliance on God's truth and justice rather than human manipulation, underscoring the need for integrity in all judgments and disputes.
